records.issue_text: [BUG] The webhook secret header lookup uses `req.headers[process.env.CALCOM_WEBHOOK_HEADER_NAME || "calcom-webhook-secret"]` without lowercasing the configured header name, but Node.js lowercases all incoming header keys. If an operator sets CALCOM_WEBHOOK_HEADER_NAME to any mixed-case value (e.g. the documented style "Calcom-Webhook-Secret"), req.headers never contains that key and every webhook request is rejected with 403, making the entire credential-sync feature silently non-functional.
